plan.goal: Compact binder-design workflow: generate two RFdiffusion binder backbones against a target structure, evaluate sequence quality per candidate, score binding affinity with Boltz-2, and rank the two candidates.
missing_inputs: target_pdb: absolute path to the target PDB structure file — required for rfdiffusion binder_design mode
target_sequence: full amino-acid sequence of the target protein — required to construct the boltz2_affinity inline sequences payload
assumptions: num_designs=2 in a single rfdiffusion call satisfies 'at most one or two binders' with minimal orchestration overhead
Binder length range 70–100 residues (RFdiffusion defaults); adjust via params.binder_length_min and params.binder_length_max
Target chain defaults to 'A'; override params.target_chain if the binding interface is on a different chain
No hotspot residues provided; rfdiffusion will sample the full target surface — supply target_hotspots to focus the interface if residues are known
boltz2_affinity runs without MSA (use_msa=false, msa_backend=none) for fast evaluation; enable MSA for production confidence
diffusion_samples=1 and diffusion_samples_affinity=3 chosen for minimal runtime; increase for production-quality affinity estimates
rfdiffusion top_candidates objects expose a 'sequence' field consumed by downstream foreach nodes

success_criteria.binders_generated: rfdiffusion produces 2 binder backbone designs stored in backbone_dir with top_candidates populated
success_criteria.sequence_quality_assessed: sequence_analysis metrics and liabilities returned per candidate
success_criteria.binding_affinity_scored: boltz2_affinity affinity_pred_value and confidence_score returned per candidate
success_criteria.ranked_output: rank_designs returns ranked_candidates with top_k=2 and ranked_tsv for downstream review
